title: LiME: Lightweight Mixture of Experts for Efficient Multimodal Multi-task Learning

target_claims.claim: LiME shares a single PEFT adapter and applies lightweight expert-specific modulation vectors instead of replicating a full adapter per expert (Figure 1).

details.architecture: Shared LoRA A, B + Expert Modulation Vectors m_e

target_claims.claim: LiME combines zero-parameter routing, adaptive expert selection, n-gram routing granularity, PEFT compatibility, and a shared trainable PEFT module (Table 1).
Average benchmark results report LiME variants as competitive with or better than MoE-PEFT baselines while using fewer total trainable parameters (Table 2).
Efficiency experiments show LiME variants achieve higher throughput, shorter training time, and up to 4x fewer trainable parameters than corresponding MoE-PEFT methods (Figure 2).
LiME's expert modulation is theoretically bounded as an approximation to expert-specific PEFT, and CKA analysis reports similar representations to MoELoRA (Theorem 2, Table 3).
